results.title: Early Winter
results.overview: Ferhat (49), a factory manager in Istanbul, and Handan (45), a bank manager, decide to have a child through surrogacy with Lia (28), a young artist of Georgian and Ukrainian descent. Shortly after their daughter Ada (1) is born, war breaks out between Russia and Ukraine. As a result, Lia is forced to stay in Istanbul with Ferhat and Handan for a while longer. Believing that surrogacy is the formula that will take her to Europe, Lia does not want to leave Ada.

results.title: She
results.overview: A choral narrative about female workers in one of the largest electronic industrial plants based in Vietnam.

results.title: Raptus
results.overview: After surviving a brutal assault, Sarah orders a new form of experimental android therapy called Raptus. But instead of helping her reclaim her mind, her new companion's controls will be pushed to the limit, putting her in extreme danger.

results.title: My Weird School
results.overview: Middle schooler AJ finds himself joining forces with faculty and friends to save the world from an alien invasion.

results.title: Behold!
results.overview: While a husband and wife grapple with the end of their failed marriage, an evil entity manifests within their home.

results.title: Son Bilet
results.overview: Barboros sets off to see a play with his wife Ceren and nine-year-old son Ali, when a luxury car crashes into his vehicle at high speed. Barboros loses his wife and son in the accident, and his grief is compounded when the driver responsible for his family's death is released.

results.title: Not All Men, But...
results.overview: Simone, a cop with conservative ideas, infiltrates a feminist collective. However, her cover is thin. To divert attention and get out of this bad situation, Simone finds nothing better than to randomly accuse a man of having raped her.

results.title: Trust
results.overview: A Hollywood starlet seeks refuge in a secluded Airbnb following a high-profile scandal, only to find herself at the mercy of hardened criminals on the hunt for a score.

results.title: The Low Land
results.overview: Carmen, a well-known writer on her fifties, has returned a year ago to a farmhouse in the small town where she was born, in Bajo Aragón (Teruel, Spain). Her vital crisis is complicated when Eduardo, a film producer with whom she had a love affair twenty years ago reappears in her life.

results.title: Invention
results.overview: In the aftermath of a conspiracy-minded father’s sudden death, his daughter inherits his patent for an experimental healing device.

results.title: Un film de merde (A shitty movie)
results.original_title: Un film de merde (A shitty movie)
results.overview: A well-formed excrement leads its companions to go to war with it.

results.title: The Sleepwatcher
results.overview: A terrifying short story and photo-montage following a group of friends on a camping trip, as they are stalked by a mysterious night creep known as The Sleepwatcher.

results.title: The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry
results.original_title: The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry
results.overview: Harold Fry was never meant to be a hero. An ordinary man in an ordinary life until a letter from a long-lost friend sends him out the front door… and he keeps on walking. From Devon’s quiet lanes to the windswept streets of Berwick-upon-Tweed, his journey becomes a pilgrimage of love, redemption, and second chances.  Strangers turn into companions, kindness appears in unexpected places, and the road reveals more than Harold ever imagined. Back home, his wife Maureen begins her own journey, one that might bring them together again.  The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry is a moving celebration of the human spirit and a reminder it’s never too late to start again.

results.title: Murugesan +2
results.overview: Murugesan+2 is a darkly comic tale about Murugesan, a truck driver leading a secret double life with two families. When he is presumed dead after a severe accident, a promised settlement sparks a bitter feud between his wives and their families, each scheming for control of the money. Just as the battle turns vicious, Murugesan returns alive, only to become a burden to those who once mourned him. Faced with betrayal and greed, Murugesan and his disillusioned sons walk away, leaving behind a biting satire on family, loyalty, and the corrupting power of money.

results.title: Rengkuh
results.overview: This is the story of Nahdiyar, who devoted his entire life to raising his younger sister, Nadirah. Thanks to his sacrifices, Nadirah blossomed into a successful animator. But just as life seemed to be looking up, everything changed—Nahdiyar was involved in an accident that left him mentally impaired.

results.title: Perla Perla
results.overview: Following a night out full of unsupervised fun and uncontrollable chaos, Perla wakes up seemingly unable to remember anything. When her acquaintances demand answers for her erratic behavior the night before, she finds herself struggling to put her life back together before her mind spirals out of control.

results.title: 12 Points
results.overview: Adam and Wiktor are obsessed with Eurovision and their hearts beat extra hard for the Swedish double winner Loreen. But the harsh jargon that prevails among the young people in their Polish town risks poisoning both their friendship and dreams of Sweden.

results.title: Desert Lone Hero
results.overview: In the Ming Dynasty, the descendant of a legendary merchant is kidnapped by bandits seeking his sealed fortune, forcing Duan Shilang to lead a band of martial heroes on a dangerous desert quest that culminates in a life-and-death showdown between good and evil.

results.title: Two Bergmans
results.overview: There are two Bergmans. One speaks English, the other Italian. They fall in love and set off impulsively to live together. But reality is far from easy. As the rift between their emotions deepens, what choice will they make? And what kind of ending awaits them?
